blocks.text:
The `ColorChooserDialog` (deprecated since gtkmm 4.10) and
`ColorDialog` (available since gtkmm 4.10) allow the user
to choose a color. The `ColorButton` (deprecated since gtkmm 4.10)
and `ColorDialogButton` (available since gtkmm 4.10) open
a color selection dialog when it is clicked.
blocks.zh: `ColorChooserDialog`（自 gtkmm 4.10 起已弃用）和 `ColorDialog`（自 gtkmm 4.10 起可用）让用户选择颜色。`ColorButton`（自 gtkmm 4.10 起已弃用）和 `ColorDialogButton`（自 gtkmm 4.10 起可用）在被点击时打开颜色选择对话框。
